sentiment.label: Mixed
sentiment.summary: Ahead of the 9:30am ET debut there is no first trade or opening indication yet, so the mood rests on pre-listing coverage: reports of strong institutional demand sit alongside continuing questions about the valuation.
points: Stocktwits reported the offer was oversubscribed about seven times, though it attributed this to reports it had not independently confirmed
A Stocktwits poll found 68% of respondents did not plan to buy in the IPO, even though retail sentiment on ANT stayed strongly bullish
Investinglive, citing the WSJ, said investors had pushed for a lower valuation than $1.5 trillion after a tech selloff
No pre-market indication was found, and the first trade may come well after the opening bell

updates.text: Anthropic prices its IPO at $83 a share, above the $70–78 range, selling 980 million shares and raising $81.3 billion. Trading on Nasdaq under ANT is expected from 9:30am New York time on 19 November.
